AAC 2015 article: Heliotrope Ridge TH used for the NW face climb, SW face only as descent - not an approach for this route. CascadeClimbers pages 403; search snippets (not opened) of 2012 and 2019 reports also said Middle Fork Nooksack. PLACEMENT CAVEAT: the USFS Middle Fork Nooksack Trailhead point (7 km-ish from the peak 5.6 km) is the official trailhead on this road system; actual parking is at a road switchback near mile 12.3 (varies by year, road closed at MP 7 by washout since Jul 2026 per route text). Coordinates of the switchback parking not found on an allowed source. Use the road name; treat the USFS point as approximate for the road, not the parking.
